ayahs.ar: اِقۡتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيۡ غَفۡلَةٍ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Iqtaraba linnaasi hisaa buhum wa hum fee ghaflatim mu'ridoon
ayahs.en: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.

ayahs.ar: مَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ ذِكۡرٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡ مُّحۡدَثٍ اِلَّا اسۡتَمَعُوۡهُ وَهُمۡ يَلۡعَبُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Maa yaateehim min zikrim mir Rabbihim muhdasin illas tama'oohu wa hum yal'aboon
ayahs.en: No mention comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play

ayahs.ar: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوۡبُهُمۡؕ وَاَسَرُّوا النَّجۡوَيࣗۖ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡاࣗۖ هَلۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡۚ اَفَتَاۡتُوۡنَ السِّحۡرَ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laahiyatan quloobuhum; wa asarrun najwal lazeena zalamoo hal haazaa illaa basharum mislukum afataa toonas sihra wa antum tubsiroon
ayahs.en: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"

ayahs.ar: قٰلَ رَبِّيۡ يَعۡلَمُ الۡقَوۡلَ فِي السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؗ وَهُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbee ya'lamul qawla fis samaaa'i wal ardi wa Huwas Samee'ul Aleem
ayahs.en: The Prophet said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَضۡغَاثُ اَحۡلَامٍۭ بَلِ افۡتَرٰىهُ بَلۡ هُوَ شَاعِرٌۚۖ فَلۡيَاۡتِنَا بِاٰيَةٍ كَمَا٘ اُرۡسِلَ الۡاَوَّلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Bal qaalooo adghaasu ahlaamim balif taraahu bal huwa shaa'irun falyaatinaa bi Aayatin kamaa ursilal awwaloon
ayahs.en: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."

ayahs.ar: مَا٘ اٰمَنَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهَاۚ اَفَهُمۡ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Maaa aaamanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaahaa a-fahum yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ اِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوۡحِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِمۡ فَسۡـَٔلُوۡ٘ا اَهۡلَ الذِّكۡرِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa arsalnaa qablaka illaa rijaalan nooheee ilaihim fas'aloo ahlaz zikri in kuntum laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا جَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ جَسَدًا لَّا يَاۡكُلُوۡنَ الطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوۡا خٰلِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa ja'alnaahum jasadal laa yaakuloonat ta'aama wa maa kaanoo khaalideen
ayahs.en: And We did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ صَدَقۡنٰهُمُ الۡوَعۡدَ فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُمۡ وَمَنۡ نَّشَآءُ وَاَهۡلَكۡنَا الۡمُسۡرِفِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: summa sadaqnaa humul wa'da fa-anjainaahum wa man nashaaa'u wa ahlaknal musrifeen
ayahs.en: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ اَنۡزَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكُمۡ كِتٰبًا فِيۡهِ ذِكۡرُكُمۡؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Laqad anzalnaaa ilaikum Kitaaban feehi zikrukum afalaa ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: We have certainly sent down to you a Book in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?

ayahs.ar: وَكَمۡ قَصَمۡنَا مِنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ كَانَتۡ ظَالِمَةً وَّاَنۡشَاۡنَا بَعۡدَهَا قَوۡمًا اٰخَرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa kam qasamnaa min qaryatin kannat zaalimatanw wa anshadnaa ba'dahaa qawman aakhareen
ayahs.en: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اَحَسُّوۡا بَاۡسَنَا٘ اِذَا هُمۡ مِّنۡهَا يَرۡكُضُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Falammaaa ahassoo baasanaaa izaaa hum minhaa yarkudoon
ayahs.en: And when its inhabitants perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.

ayahs.ar: لَا تَرۡكُضُوۡا وَارۡجِعُوۡ٘ا اِلٰي مَا٘ اُتۡرِفۡتُمۡ فِيۡهِ وَمَسٰكِنِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laa tarkudoo warji'ooo ilaa maaa utriftum feehe wa masaakinikum la'allakum tus'aloon
ayahs.en: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰوَيۡلَنَا٘ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo yaa wailanaaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen
ayahs.en: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

ayahs.ar: فَمَا زَالَتۡ تِّلۡكَ دَعۡوٰىهُمۡ حَتّٰي جَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ حَصِيۡدًا خٰمِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Famaa zaalat tilka da'waahum hattaa ja'alnaahum haseedan khaamideen
ayahs.en: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمَآءَ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لٰعِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa khalaqnas samaaa'a wal arda wa maa bainahumaa laa'ibeen
ayahs.en: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.

ayahs.ar: لَوۡ اَرَدۡنَا٘ اَنۡ نَّتَّخِذَ لَهۡوًا لَّاتَّخَذۡنٰهُ مِنۡ لَّدُنَّا٘ࣗۖ اِنۡ كُنَّا فٰعِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Law aradnaaa an nattakhiza lahwal lat takhaznaahu mil ladunnaaa in kunnaa faa'ileen
ayahs.en: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ نَقۡذِفُ بِالۡحَقِّ عَلَي الۡبَاطِلِ فَيَدۡمَغُهٗ فَاِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌؕ وَلَكُمُ الۡوَيۡلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Bal naqzifu bilhaqqi 'alal baatili fa yadmaghuhoo fa izaa huwa zaahiq; wa lakumul wailu mimmaa tasifoon
ayahs.en: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.

ayahs.ar: وَلَهٗ مَنۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَمَنۡ عِنۡدَهٗ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِهٖ وَلَا يَسۡتَحۡسِرُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lahoo man fis samaawaati wal ard; wa man 'indahoo laa yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaada tihee wa laa yastahsiroon
ayahs.en: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.

ayahs.ar: يُسَبِّحُوۡنَ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لَا يَفۡتُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yusabbihoona laila wannahaara laa yafturoon
ayahs.en: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.

ayahs.ar: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوۡ٘ا اٰلِهَةً مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ هُمۡ يُنۡشِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Amit takhazooo aalihatam minal ardi hum yunshiroon
ayahs.en: Or have men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?

ayahs.ar: لَوۡ كَانَ فِيۡهِمَا٘ اٰلِهَةٌ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ لَفَسَدَتَاۚ فَسُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Law kaana feehimaaa aalihatun illal laahu lafasadataa; fa-Subhaanal laahi Rabbil 'Arshi 'ammaa yasifoon
ayahs.en: Had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides Allah, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allah, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.

ayahs.ar: لَا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفۡعَلُ وَهُمۡ يُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laa yus'alu 'ammaa yaf'alu wa hum yus'aloon
ayahs.en: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.

ayahs.ar: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اٰلِهَةًؕ قُلۡ هَاتُوۡا بُرۡهَانَكُمۡۚ هٰذَا ذِكۡرُ مَنۡ مَّعِيَ وَذِكۡرُ مَنۡ قَبۡلِيۡؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ الۡحَقَّ فَهُمۡ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Amit takhazoo min doonihee aalihatan qul haatoo burhaanakum haaza zikru mam ma'iya wa zikru man qablee; bal aksaruhum laa ya'lamoonal haqqa fahum mu'ridoon
ayahs.en: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muhammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur'an] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ مِنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا نُوۡحِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِ اَنَّهٗ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا٘ اَنَا فَاعۡبُدُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa arsalnaa min qablika mir Rasoolin illaa nooheee ilaihi annahoo laaa ilaaha illaaa Ana fa'budoon
ayahs.en: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَلَدًا سُبۡحٰنَهٗؕ بَلۡ عِبَادٌ مُّكۡرَمُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalut takhazar Rahmaanu waladan Subhaanah; bal 'ibaadum mkkramoon
ayahs.en: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.

ayahs.ar: لَا يَسۡبِقُوۡنَهٗ بِالۡقَوۡلِ وَهُمۡ بِاَمۡرِهٖ يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laa yasbiqoonahoo bil qawli wa hum bi amrihee ya'maloon
ayahs.en: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.

ayahs.ar: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يَشۡفَعُوۡنَۙ اِلَّا لِمَنِ ارۡتَضٰي وَهُمۡ مِّنۡ خَشۡيَتِهٖ مُشۡفِقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ya'lamu maa baina aideehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yashfa'oona illaa limanir tadaa wa hum min khash yatihee mushfiqoon
ayahs.en: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّقُلۡ مِنۡهُمۡ اِنِّيۡ٘ اِلٰهٌ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ فَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِيۡهِ جَهَنَّمَؕ كَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي الظّٰلِمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa mai yaqul minhum inneee ilaahum min doonihee fazaalika najzeehi Jahannam; kazaalika najziz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him"- that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اَنَّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ كَانَتَا رَتۡقًا فَفَتَقۡنٰهُمَاؕ وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنَ الۡمَآءِ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ حَيٍّؕ اَفَلَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Awalam yaral lazeena kafarooo annas samaawaati wal arda kaanataa ratqan faftaqnaahumaa wa ja'alnaa minal maaa'i kulla shai'in haiyin afalaa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ رَوَاسِيَ اَنۡ تَمِيۡدَ بِهِمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيۡهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ja'alnaa fil ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bihim wa ja'alnaa feehaa fijaajan subulal la'allahum yahtadoon
ayahs.en: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا السَّمَآءَ سَقۡفًا مَّحۡفُوۡظًاۚۖ وَّهُمۡ عَنۡ اٰيٰتِهَا مُعۡرِضُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ja'alnas samaaa'a saqfam mahfoozanw wa hum 'an Aayaatihaa mu'ridoon
ayahs.en: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَؕ كُلٌّ فِيۡ فَلَكٍ يَّسۡبَحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Huwal lazee khalaqal laila wannahaara washshamsa wal qamara kullun fee falakiny yashbahoon
ayahs.en: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكَ الۡخُلۡدَؕ اَفَا۠ئِنۡ مِّتَّ فَهُمُ الۡخٰلِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa ja'alnaa libasharim min qablikal khuld; afaimmitta fahumul khaalidoon
ayahs.en: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?

ayahs.ar: كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ الۡمَوۡتِؕ وَنَبۡلُوۡكُمۡ بِالشَّرِّ وَالۡخَيۡرِ فِتۡنَةًؕ وَاِلَيۡنَا تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Kullu nafsin zaaa'iqatul mawt; wa nablookum bishsharri walkhairi fitnatanw wa ilainaa turja'oon
ayahs.en: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا رَاٰكَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ يَّتَّخِذُوۡنَكَ اِلَّا هُزُوًاؕ اَهٰذَا الَّذِيۡ يَذۡكُرُ اٰلِهَتَكُمۡۚ وَهُمۡ بِذِكۡرِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ هُمۡ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa ra aakal lazeena kafarooo iny-yattakhizoonaka illa huzuwaa; ahaazal lazee yazkuru aalihatakum wa hum bi zikrir Rahmaani hum kaafiroon
ayahs.en: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who insults your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: خُلِقَ الۡاِنۡسَانُ مِنۡ عَجَلٍؕ سَاُورِيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِيۡ فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Khuliqal insaanu min 'ajal; sa ureekum Aayaatee falaa tasta'jiloon
ayahs.en: Man was created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not impatiently urge Me.

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

ayahs.ar: لَوۡ يَعۡلَمُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا حِيۡنَ لَا يَكُفُّوۡنَ عَنۡ وُّجُوۡهِهِمُ النَّارَ وَلَا عَنۡ ظُهُوۡرِهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Law ya'lamul lazeena kafaroo heena laa yakuffoona 'anw wujoohihimun Naara wa laa 'an zuhoorihim wa laa hum yunsaroon
ayahs.en: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ تَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ بَغۡتَةً فَتَبۡهَتُهُمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡظَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Bal taateehim baghtatan fatabhatuhum falaa yastatee'oona raddahaa wa laa hum yunzaroon
ayahs.en: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدِ اسۡتُهۡزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِالَّذِيۡنَ سَخِرُوۡا مِنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqadis tuhzi'a bi-Rusulim min qablika fahaaqa billazeena sakhiroo minhum maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
ayahs.en: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَنۡ يَّكۡلَؤُكُمۡ بِالَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِ مِنَ الرَّحۡمٰنِؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul mai yakla 'ukum billaili wannahaari minar Rahmaan; bal hum 'an zikri Rabbihim mu'ridoon
ayahs.en: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ اٰلِهَةٌ تَمۡنَعُهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِنَاؕ لَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ نَصۡرَ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ مِّنَّا يُصۡحَبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Am lahum aalihatun tamna'ulum min dooninaa; laa yastatee'oona nasra anfusihim wa laa hum minnna yus-haboon
ayahs.en: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡنَا هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ وَاٰبَآءَهُمۡ حَتّٰي طَالَ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡعُمُرُؕ اَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ اَنَّا نَاۡتِي الۡاَرۡضَ نَنۡقُصُهَا مِنۡ اَطۡرَافِهَاؕ اَفَهُمُ الۡغٰلِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Bal matta'naa haaa'ulaaa'i wa aabaaa'ahum hattaa taala 'alaihimul 'umur; afalaa yarawna anna naatil arda nanqusuhaa min atraafihaa; afahumul ghaaliboon
ayahs.en: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? So it is they who will overcome?

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اُنۡذِرُكُمۡ بِالۡوَحۡيِؗۖ وَلَا يَسۡمَعُ الصُّمُّ الدُّعَآءَ اِذَا مَا يُنۡذَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul innamaaa unzirukum bilwahyi; wa laa yasma'us summud du'aaa'a izaa maa yunzaroon
ayahs.en: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنۡ مَّسَّتۡهُمۡ نَفۡحَةٌ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ يٰوَيۡلَنَا٘ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa la'im massat hum nafhatum min 'azaabi Rabbika la yaqoolunna yaawailanaaa innnaa kunnaa zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."

ayahs.ar: وَنَضَعُ الۡمَوَازِيۡنَ الۡقِسۡطَ لِيَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٌ شَيۡـًٔاؕ وَاِنۡ كَانَ مِثۡقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنۡ خَرۡدَلٍ اَتَيۡنَا بِهَاؕ وَكَفٰي بِنَا حٰسِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa nada'ul mawaazeenal qista li Yawmil Qiyaamati falaa tuzlamu nafsun shai'aa; wa in kaana misqaala habbatim min khardalin atainaa bihaa; wa kafaa binaa haasibeen
ayahs.en: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسٰي وَهٰرُوۡنَ الۡفُرۡقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَّذِكۡرًا لِّلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad aatainaa Moosa wa haaroonal Furqaana wa diyaa'anw wa zikral lilmuttaqeen
ayahs.en: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ بِالۡغَيۡبِ وَهُمۡ مِّنَ السَّاعَةِ مُشۡفِقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yakhshawna Rabbahum bilghaibi wa hum minas Saa'ati mushfiqoon
ayahs.en: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.

ayahs.ar: وَهٰذَا ذِكۡرٌ مُّبٰرَكٌ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُؕ اَفَاَنۡتُمۡ لَهٗ مُنۡكِرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa haazaa Zikrum Mubaarakun anzalnaah; afa antum lahoo munkiroon
ayahs.en: And this [Qur'an] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ رُشۡدَهٗ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَكُنَّا بِهٖ عٰلِمِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad aatainaaa Ibraaheema rushdahoo min qablu wa kunnaa bihee 'aalimeen
ayahs.en: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لِاَبِيۡهِ وَقَوۡمِهٖ مَا هٰذِهِ التَّمَاثِيۡلُ الَّتِيۡ٘ اَنۡتُمۡ لَهَا عٰكِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala li abeehi wa qawmihee maa haazihit tamaaseelul lateee antum lahee 'aakifoon
ayahs.en: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا وَجَدۡنَا٘ اٰبَآءَنَا لَهَا عٰبِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo wajadnaaa aabaaa'anaa lahaa 'aabideen
ayahs.en: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَقَدۡ كُنۡتُمۡ اَنۡتُمۡ وَاٰبَآؤُكُمۡ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Qaala laqad kuntum antum wa aabaaa'ukum fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.en: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَجِئۡتَنَا بِالۡحَقِّ اَمۡ اَنۡتَ مِنَ اللّٰعِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo aji'tanaa bil haqqi am anta minal laa'ibeen
ayahs.en: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ بَلۡ رَّبُّكُمۡ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ الَّذِيۡ فَطَرَهُنَّؗۖ وَاَنَا عَلٰي ذٰلِكُمۡ مِّنَ الشّٰهِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala bar Rabbukum Rabbus samaawaati wal ardil lazee fatarahunna wa ana 'alaa zaalikum minash shaahideen
ayahs.en: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.

ayahs.ar: وَتَاللّٰهِ لَاَكِيۡدَنَّ اَصۡنَامَكُمۡ بَعۡدَ اَنۡ تُوَلُّوۡا مُدۡبِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa tallaahi la akeedanna asnaamakum ba'da an tuwalloo mudbireen
ayahs.en: And [I swear] by Allah, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."

ayahs.ar: فَجَعَلَهُمۡ جُذٰذًا اِلَّا كَبِيۡرًا لَّهُمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ اِلَيۡهِ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Faja'alahum juzaazan illaa kabeeral lahum la'allahum ilaihi yarji'oon
ayahs.en: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا مَنۡ فَعَلَ هٰذَا بِاٰلِهَتِنَا٘ اِنَّهٗ لَمِنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo man fa'ala haazaa bi aalihatinaaa innahoo laminaz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا سَمِعۡنَا فَتًي يَّذۡكُرُهُمۡ يُقَالُ لَهٗ٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo sami'naa fatany yazkuruhum yuqaalu lahooo Ibraaheem
ayahs.en: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا فَاۡتُوۡا بِهٖ عَلٰ٘ي اَعۡيُنِ النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَشۡهَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo faatoo bihee 'alaaa a'yunin naasi la'allahum yash hadoon
ayahs.en: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا ءَاَنۡتَ فَعَلۡتَ هٰذَا بِاٰلِهَتِنَا يٰ٘اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo 'a-anta fa'alta haazaa bi aalihatinaa yaaa Ibraaheem
ayahs.en: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ بَلۡ فَعَلَهٗࣗۖ كَبِيۡرُهُمۡ هٰذَا فَسۡـَٔلُوۡهُمۡ اِنۡ كَانُوۡا يَنۡطِقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala bal fa'alahoo kabeeruhum haazaa fas'aloohum in kaanoo yantiqoon
ayahs.en: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."

ayahs.ar: فَرَجَعُوۡ٘ا اِلٰ٘ي اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ فَقَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّكُمۡ اَنۡتُمُ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Faraja'ooo ilaaa anfusihim faqaalooo innakum antumuz zaalimoon
ayahs.en: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوۡا عَلٰي رُءُوۡسِهِمۡۚ لَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتَ مَا هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ يَنۡطِقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summa nukisoo 'alaa ru'oosihim laqad 'alimta maa haaa'ulaaa'i yantiqoon
ayahs.en: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَفَتَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَنۡفَعُكُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا يَضُرُّكُمۡؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala afata'budoona min doonil laahi maa laa yanfa'ukum shai'anw wa laa yadurrukum
ayahs.en: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allah that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?

ayahs.ar: اُفٍّ لَّكُمۡ وَلِمَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Uffil lakum wa limaa ta'budoona min doonil laah; afalaa ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allah. Then will you not use reason?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا حَرِّقُوۡهُ وَانۡصُرُوۡ٘ا اٰلِهَتَكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ فٰعِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo harriqooho wansurooo aalihatakum in kuntum faa'ileen
ayahs.en: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡنَا يٰنَارُ كُوۡنِيۡ بَرۡدًا وَّسَلٰمًا عَلٰ٘ي اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qulnaa yaa naaru koonee bardanw wa salaaman 'alaaa Ibraaheem
ayahs.en: Allah said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."

ayahs.ar: وَاَرَادُوۡا بِهٖ كَيۡدًا فَجَعَلۡنٰهُمُ الۡاَخۡسَرِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa araadoo bihee kaidan faja'alnaahumul akhsareen
ayahs.en: And they intended for him harm, but We made them the greatest losers.

ayahs.ar: وَنَجَّيۡنٰهُ وَلُوۡطًا اِلَي الۡاَرۡضِ الَّتِيۡ بٰرَكۡنَا فِيۡهَا لِلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa najjainaahu wa Lootan ilal ardil latee baaraknaa feehaa lil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds.

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهٗ٘ اِسۡحٰقَؕ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَ نَافِلَةًؕ وَكُلًّا جَعَلۡنَا صٰلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa wahabnaa lahooo Ishaaq; wa Ya'qooba naafilah; wa kullan ja'alnaa saaliheen
ayahs.en: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ اَئِمَّةً يَّهۡدُوۡنَ بِاَمۡرِنَا وَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِمۡ فِعۡلَ الۡخَيۡرٰتِ وَاِقَامَ الصَّلٰوةِ وَاِيۡتَآءَ الزَّكٰوةِۚ وَكَانُوۡا لَنَا عٰبِدِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ja'alnaahum a'immatany yahdoona bi amrinaa wa awhainaaa ilaihim fi'lal khairaati wa iqaamas Salaati wa eetaaa'az Zakaati wa kaanoo lanaa 'aabideen
ayahs.en: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakah; and they were worshippers of Us.

ayahs.ar: وَلُوۡطًا اٰتَيۡنٰهُ حُكۡمًا وَّعِلۡمًا وَّنَجَّيۡنٰهُ مِنَ الۡقَرۡيَةِ الَّتِيۡ كَانَتۡ تَّعۡمَلُ الۡخَبٰٓئِثَؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمَ سَوۡءٍ فٰسِقِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa Lootan aatainaahu hukmanw wa 'ilmanw wa najjainaahu minal qaryatil latee kaanat ta'malul khabaaa'is; innahum kaanoo qawma saw'in faasiqeen
ayahs.en: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.

ayahs.ar: وَاَدۡخَلۡنٰهُ فِيۡ رَحۡمَتِنَاؕ اِنَّهٗ مِنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa adkhalnaahu fee rahmatinaa innahoo minas saalihee
ayahs.en: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.

ayahs.ar: وَنُوۡحًا اِذۡ نَادٰي مِنۡ قَبۡلُ فَاسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهٗ فَنَجَّيۡنٰهُ وَاَهۡلَهٗ مِنَ الۡكَرۡبِ الۡعَظِيۡمِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa noohan iz naadaa min qablu fastajabnaa lahoo fanajjainaahu wa ahlahoo minal karbil 'azeem
ayahs.en: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allah] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great flood.

ayahs.ar: وَنَصَرۡنٰهُ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَاؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمَ سَوۡءٍ فَاَغۡرَقۡنٰهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa nasarnaahu minal qawmil lazeena kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa; innahum kkaanoo qawma saw'in fa-aghraq naahum ajma'een
ayahs.en: And We saved him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.

ayahs.ar: وَدَاوٗدَ وَسُلَيۡمٰنَ اِذۡ يَحۡكُمٰنِ فِي الۡحَرۡثِ اِذۡ نَفَشَتۡ فِيۡهِ غَنَمُ الۡقَوۡمِۚ وَكُنَّا لِحُكۡمِهِمۡ شٰهِدِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa Daawooda wa Sulaimaana iz yahkumaani fil harsi iz nafashat feehi ghanamul qawmi wa kunnaa lihukmihim shaahideen
ayahs.en: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement.

ayahs.ar: فَفَهَّمۡنٰهَا سُلَيۡمٰنَۚ وَكُلًّا اٰتَيۡنَا حُكۡمًا وَّعِلۡمًاؗ وَّسَخَّرۡنَا مَعَ دَاوٗدَ الۡجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحۡنَ وَالطَّيۡرَؕ وَكُنَّا فٰعِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fafahhamnaahaa sulaimaan; wa kullan aatainaa hukmanw wa'ilmanw wa sakh kharnaa ma'a Daawoodal jibaala yusabbihna wattayr; wa kunnaa faa'ileen
ayahs.en: And We gave understanding of the case to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].

ayahs.ar: وَعَلَّمۡنٰهُ صَنۡعَةَ لَبُوۡسٍ لَّكُمۡ لِتُحۡصِنَكُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَاۡسِكُمۡۚ فَهَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ شٰكِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa 'allamanaahu san'ata laboosil lakum lituhsinakum mim baasikum fahal antum shaakiroon
ayahs.en: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?

ayahs.ar: وَلِسُلَيۡمٰنَ الرِّيۡحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجۡرِيۡ بِاَمۡرِهٖ٘ اِلَي الۡاَرۡضِ الَّتِيۡ بٰرَكۡنَا فِيۡهَاؕ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa li Sulaimaanar reeha 'aasifatan tajree bi amriheee ilal ardil latee baaraknaa feehaa; wa kunnaa bikulli shai'in 'aalimeen
ayahs.en: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ الشَّيٰطِيۡنِ مَنۡ يَّغُوۡصُوۡنَ لَهٗ وَيَعۡمَلُوۡنَ عَمَلًا دُوۡنَ ذٰلِكَۚ وَكُنَّا لَهُمۡ حٰفِظِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa minash Shayaateeni mai yaghoosoona lahoo wa ya'maloona 'amalan doona zaalika wa kunna lahum baafizeen
ayahs.en: And of the devils were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.

ayahs.ar: وَاَيُّوۡبَ اِذۡ نَادٰي رَبَّهٗ٘ اَنِّيۡ مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَاَنۡتَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa Ayyooba iz naadaa Rabbahooo annee massaniyad durru wa Anta arhamur raahimeen
ayahs.en: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful."

ayahs.ar: فَاسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهٗ فَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهٖ مِنۡ ضُرٍّ وَّاٰتَيۡنٰهُ اَهۡلَهٗ وَمِثۡلَهُمۡ مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ عِنۡدِنَا وَذِكۡرٰي لِلۡعٰبِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fastajabnaa lahoo fakashaf naa maa bihee min durrinw wa aatainaahu ahlahoo wa mislahum ma'ahum rahmatam min 'indinaa wa zikraa lil'aabideen
ayahs.en: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allah].

ayahs.ar: وَاِسۡمٰعِيۡلَ وَاِدۡرِيۡسَ وَذَا الۡكِفۡلِؕ كُلٌّ مِّنَ الصّٰبِرِيۡنَۙۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa Ismaa'eela wa Idreesa wa Zal Kifli kullum minas saabireen
ayahs.en: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.

ayahs.ar: وَاَدۡخَلۡنٰهُمۡ فِيۡ رَحۡمَتِنَاؕ اِنَّهُمۡ مِّنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa adkhalnaahum fee rahmatinaa innahum minas saaliheen
ayahs.en: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.

ayahs.ar: وَذَا النُّوۡنِ اِذۡ ذَّهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ اَنۡ لَّنۡ نَّقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ فَنَادٰي فِي الظُّلُمٰتِ اَنۡ لَّا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡتَ سُبۡحٰنَكَࣗۖ اِنِّيۡ كُنۡتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa Zan Nooni iz zahaba mughaadiban fazaanna al lan naqdira 'alaihi fanaanna al lan naqdira 'alaihi fanaadaa fiz zulumaati al laaa ilaaha illaaa Anta Subhaanaka innee kuntu minaz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And [mention] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."

ayahs.ar: فَاسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهٗۙ وَنَجَّيۡنٰهُ مِنَ الۡغَمِّؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ نُۨجِي الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fastajabnaa lahoo wa najjainaahu minal ghamm; wa kazaalika nunjil mu'mineen
ayahs.en: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.

ayahs.ar: وَزَكَرِيَّا٘ اِذۡ نَادٰي رَبَّهٗ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرۡنِيۡ فَرۡدًا وَّاَنۡتَ خَيۡرُ الۡوٰرِثِيۡنَۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa Zakariyyaaa iz naadaa Rabbahoo Rabbi laa tazarnee fardanw wa Anta khairul waariseen
ayahs.en: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors."

ayahs.ar: فَاسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهٗؗ وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهٗ يَحۡيٰي وَاَصۡلَحۡنَا لَهٗ زَوۡجَهٗؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا يُسٰرِعُوۡنَ فِي الۡخَيۡرٰتِ وَيَدۡعُوۡنَنَا رَغَبًا وَّرَهَبًاؕ وَكَانُوۡا لَنَا خٰشِعِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fastajabnaa lahoo wa wahabnaa lahoo Yahyaa Wa aslahnaa lahoo zawjah; innahum kaanoo yusaari'oona fil khairaati wa yad'oonanaa raghabanw wa rahabaa; wa kaanoo lanaa khaashi'een
ayahs.en: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّتِيۡ٘ اَحۡصَنَتۡ فَرۡجَهَا فَنَفَخۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنۡ رُّوۡحِنَا وَجَعَلۡنٰهَا وَابۡنَهَا٘ اٰيَةً لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallateee ahsanat farjahaa fanafakhnaa feehaa mir roohinaa wa ja'alnaahaa wabnahaaa Aayatal lil'aalameen
ayahs.en: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity, so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ٘ اُمَّتُكُمۡ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةًؗۖ وَّاَنَا رَبُّكُمۡ فَاعۡبُدُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Inna haaziheee ummatukum ummatanw waahidatanw wa Ana Rabbukum fa'budoon
ayahs.en: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.

ayahs.ar: وَتَقَطَّعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرَهُمۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ كُلٌّ اِلَيۡنَا رٰجِعُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa taqatta'ooo amrahum bainahum kullun ilainaaa raaji'oon
ayahs.en: And [yet] they divided their affair among themselves, [but] all to Us will return.

ayahs.ar: فَمَنۡ يَّعۡمَلۡ مِنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٌ فَلَا كُفۡرَانَ لِسَعۡيِهٖۚ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ كٰتِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Famai ya'mal minas saalihaati wa huwa mu'minun falaa kufraana lisa'yihee wa innaa lahoo kaatiboon
ayahs.en: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We, of it, are recorders.

ayahs.ar: وَحَرٰمٌ عَلٰي قَرۡيَةٍ اَهۡلَكۡنٰهَا٘ اَنَّهُمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa haraamun 'alaa qaryatin ahlaknaahaaa annahum laa yarji'oon
ayahs.en: And there is prohibition upon [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return

ayahs.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا فُتِحَتۡ يَاۡجُوۡجُ وَمَاۡجُوۡجُ وَهُمۡ مِّنۡ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَّنۡسِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Hattaaa izaa futihat Yaajooju wa Maajooju wa hum min kulli hadabiny yansiloon
ayahs.en: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend

ayahs.ar: وَاقۡتَرَبَ الۡوَعۡدُ الۡحَقُّ فَاِذَا هِيَ شَاخِصَةٌ اَبۡصَارُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡاؕ يٰوَيۡلَنَا قَدۡ كُنَّا فِيۡ غَفۡلَةٍ مِّنۡ هٰذَا بَلۡ كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Waqtarabal wa'dul haqqu fa-izaa hiya shaakhisatun absaarul lazeena kafaroo yaawailanaa qad kunna fee ghaflatim min haaza bal kunnaa zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And [when] the true promise has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَؕ اَنۡتُمۡ لَهَا وٰرِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innakum wa maa ta'budoona min doonil laahi hasabu Jahannama antum lahaa waaridoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allah are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it.

ayahs.ar: لَوۡ كَانَ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ اٰلِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوۡهَاؕ وَكُلٌّ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Law kaana haaa'ulaaa'i aalihatam maa waradoohaa wa kullun feehaa khaalidoon
ayahs.en: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.

ayahs.ar: لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا زَفِيۡرٌ وَّهُمۡ فِيۡهَا لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Lahum feehaa zafeerunw wa hum feehaa laa yasma'oon
ayahs.en: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ سَبَقَتۡ لَهُمۡ مِّنَّا الۡحُسۡنٰ٘يۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ عَنۡهَا مُبۡعَدُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena sabaqat lahum minnal husnaaa ulaaa'ika 'anhaa mub'adoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.

ayahs.ar: لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ حَسِيۡسَهَاۚ وَهُمۡ فِيۡ مَا اشۡتَهَتۡ اَنۡفُسُهُمۡ خٰلِدُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Laa yasma'oona hasee sahaa wa hum fee mash tahat anfusuhum khaalidoon
ayahs.en: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.

ayahs.ar: لَا يَحۡزُنُهُمُ الۡفَزَعُ الۡاَكۡبَرُ وَتَتَلَقّٰىهُمُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُؕ هٰذَا يَوۡمُكُمُ الَّذِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laa yahzunuhumul faza'ul akbaru wa tatalaq qaahumul malaaa'ikatu haazaa Yawmukumul lazee kuntum too'adoon
ayahs.en: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised" -

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ نَطۡوِي السَّمَآءَ كَطَيِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلۡكُتُبِؕ كَمَا بَدَاۡنَا٘ اَوَّلَ خَلۡقٍ نُّعِيۡدُهٗؕ وَعۡدًا عَلَيۡنَاؕ اِنَّا كُنَّا فٰعِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yawma natwis samaaa'a kataiyis sijilli lilkutub; kamaa badaanaa awwala khalqin nu'eeduh; wa'dan 'alainaa; innaa kunna faa'ileen
ayahs.en: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ كَتَبۡنَا فِي الزَّبُوۡرِ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ الذِّكۡرِ اَنَّ الۡاَرۡضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ الصّٰلِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad katabnaa fiz Zaboori mim ba'diz zikri annal arda yarisuhaa 'ibaadi yas saalihoon
ayahs.en: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ هٰذَا لَبَلٰغًا لِّقَوۡمٍ عٰبِدِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Inna fee haaza labalaa ghal liqawmin 'aabideen
ayahs.en: Indeed, in this [Qur'an] is notification for a worshipping people.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنٰكَ اِلَّا رَحۡمَةً لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa arsalnaaka illaa rahmatal lil'aalameen
ayahs.en: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا يُوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيَّ اَنَّمَا٘ اِلٰهُكُمۡ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌۚ فَهَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّسۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul innamaa yoohaa ilaiya annamaaa ilaahukum illaahunw Waahid, fahal antum muslimoon
ayahs.en: Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?"

ayahs.ar: فَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَقُلۡ اٰذَنۡتُكُمۡ عَلٰي سَوَآءٍؕ وَاِنۡ اَدۡرِيۡ٘ اَقَرِيۡبٌ اَمۡ بَعِيۡدٌ مَّا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa in tawallaw faqul aazantukum 'alaa sawaaa'; wa in adreee aqareebun am ba'eedum maa too'adoon
ayahs.en: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally. And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّهٗ يَعۡلَمُ الۡجَهۡرَ مِنَ الۡقَوۡلِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تَكۡتُمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innahoo ya'lamul jahra minal qawli wa ya'lamu maa taktumoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ اَدۡرِيۡ لَعَلَّهٗ فِتۡنَةٌ لَّكُمۡ وَمَتَاعٌ اِلٰي حِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa in adree la'allahoo fitnatul lakum wa mataa'un ilaaheen
ayahs.en: And I know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."

ayahs.ar: قٰلَ رَبِّ احۡكُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّؕ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحۡمٰنُ الۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلٰي مَا تَصِفُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbih kum bil haqq; wa Rabbunar Rahmaa nul musta'aanu 'alaa maa tasifoon
ayahs.en: [The Prophet] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."
